hybridLibrary.authority: ADR100 lazy Library and choice-free branches, October 9, extends ADR099 readable labels, ADR098 insight/remembered-position behavior and ADR097 stable navigation. Choice-free chains may follow any selected node, stopping at a leaf, fork or direct evidence plus child choice. Individual insights never auto-open. Earlier pair/grid, detached evidence and mascot-shell rules remain historical where superseded.
hybridLibrary.geometry: 1040px Library cap with 20px inset, removed at 760px and below. Stationary adjacent Tree/Folders and Personal/Business toolbar capped at 600px. Ordered horizontal sibling rows use frontmatter desktop/phone widths and multiword word-boundary wrapping for up to three lines and single-word ellipsis with complete accessible names. Measured SVG connects category rectangles and selected topic to evidence; both views repeat the topic beside Insights. Closed branches lose active treatment.
hybridLibrary.responsive: Final mobile override at 760px. Single-word categories retain 56px minimum height, 52px in Folders. Multiword Tree cards have a 64px minimum height and grow for up to three lines. Folders retains its 52px minimum and grows with wrapped labels. Stacked insight buttons grow naturally with full titles and have 80px minimum height and 42px semantic icons, 36px on phones. Compact type and control radii retain operative density; right-side number bubbles use pill corners and a 24px height. Stable five bottom actions, centered yellow Save, related destination for nested Library/Projects pages and Account current-page marker. Save labels use theme Subtle in both themes. Original favicon and authenticated HTTPS avatar/first-name fallback remain.
hybridLibrary.pagination: One initial automatic bounded topic/proposal batch when the sentinel approaches within 160px of the viewport; subsequent batches require a new wheel, touch-browse or navigation-key gesture. Cursor changes and empty filtered pages cannot drain pages; duplicate attempts are fenced and hidden tabs do not page. Load more topics is the accessible manual fallback. Returned metadata and ancestors remain without forty-node eviction, preserving sibling order. Focus/scope/search revalidation replaces metadata and clears prior proposal proof. Category paging reuses open evidence. Both Tree and Folders show five initial insights, reveal five more and append further evidence pages explicitly through More insights, disabled while loading. Appends preserve evidence position; fresh selection or revalidation resets it.
hybridLibrary.boundary: Filing grants no access. One indexed five-proposal page accompanies a topic browse batch; further pages share the visibility/gesture gate. No per-card request, whole-table scan, inference, provider polling or background cursor drain. Library shows open proposals only; closed, rejected and merged records remain in Projects. Exact source/insight/generation/revision citations, current publication versions, bound run observations and server authority remain required. Deleted/stale/mismatched records are excluded. Numeric right-side bubbles require all pages complete and deduplicate proposal IDs across citations and descendants, never summing overlapping child totals. Pending pages, unknown lifecycle state, reference/membership caps and malformed or over-depth hierarchy withhold totals. Exact review links grant no coding, publication or spending approval.

The fresh finish reviewer identified obsolete persistence descriptions; this refresh addresses those documentation findings. Whole-library composition, hero and drift gates remain open. These checks establish no production release, real historical-proposal acceptance, independent human comprehension, physical-phone motion, provider/cost settlement or whole-plan acceptance. Builder opened the five captures in .impeccable/review/library-labels/ and reports 557 unit passes, three external skips, 28 authentication passes, Python suites of 6/6/3, five Basic-build checks, both builds and dependency audit passed. Application 306a0ec01ff85d167b7ea676d9a62006d8e38098, alpha 0.1.0-alpha.20261009130048.g306a0ec01ff8, was verified on canonical production within its owner-page scope; documentation main8672456 is historical. hybridLibrary.compactEvidence: Stored descriptive insight titles wrap fully and rows grow naturally without a title clamp. Fixed semantic whitelist icons and pastel tone by semantic key remain stable through reordering. Legacy display uses deterministic fallback; new completions persist an omitted icon fallback without historical rewriting or reanalysis. Full unchanged claim, source title and source navigation expand in-row. View source evidence uses the shared outline Button with link semantics and a 44px target. Exact proposal row shows title, project, recorded state and bounded 500-character description clamped to two lines, linking to the full authorized exact-draft review.
hybridLibrary.motion: Sequential 220ms outgoing close/incoming open and 200ms insight height/opacity with cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Nested Motion completion callbacks consume the close/open handoff once. Hidden content is immediately inert/aria-hidden. Keyboard and live system/app motion suppression are immediate. Evidence arrival does not remount navigation. Scope/search resets cancel pending restoration. Motion starts no inference or new polling.
hybridLibrary.history: ADRs095-096 pair/grid composition, prior 78% drift FAIL/hard veto, earlier stack captures, animation counts and release receipts retain their dates and scopes. Verified ADR097 and ADR098 releases do not establish current ADR100 release or full V1 acceptance.
hybridLibrary.restoration: Identifiers/geometry only in workspace/scope browser keys: representation, filing, topic, closed branch, expanded insight, bounded page and row scroll. Fresh authorized topics validate topic/closed IDs and returned members validate insight. Missing/revoked topics discard insight/geometry; missing saved entries use fresh Tree/available filing overview. Scope/search resets clear place and pending restoration, access loss clears preferences. Current filing root opens by default.
hybridLibrary.explanations: Small metric and connection notes use labeled circle-help disclosures with 44px targets. Essential errors and task controls stay visible.
hybridLibrary.organization: The version-bound topic-parent form is inside Library options rather than inline evidence. Its disclosure is Move followed by the selected topic name, its destination label is Parent category and its submit label is Move topic. Moving a topic changes filing only, grants no access and starts no analysis.
hybridLibrary.navigation: Follow only-child chains from any returned node in both Tree and Folders. Stop at a leaf, fork or direct evidence plus child choice; no individual insight auto-opens. Preserve explicit collapse and scoped remembered place. Paths remain twelve-level bounded and missing parents/cycles grant no access.
hybridLibrary.loading: react-loading-skeleton 3.5.0, MIT, supplies metadata, insight and proposal placeholders with Line/Panel tones and 1.6s shimmer; system reduced motion and app motion-off suppress animation. Failed reads clear the view and show Retry loading library.
hybridLibrary.demo: Read-only, explicitly synthetic fixed citations include three distinct open proposals and two closed/merged examples retained in Projects, with matching full source/proposal routes. No inference, provider polling or backend writes.

narrative.overview:
The app uses cool canvas, white reading surfaces, navy ink and teal selection. Its matching dark theme keeps the same hierarchy. Quiet borders and compact icon-led cards let saved knowledge and the next permitted action lead. Device setting is the default appearance; Account offers Light and Dark overrides.

This is the owner-authorized October 9 application world, extracted from the built code. Its boundary is the Atlas shell, Home, Library, Projects, Account and capture. The public marketing world remains Scroll's charcoal studio. The app logo uses the actual favicon artwork and links to Home. Home and the mobile header no longer show the mascot or top account control under [ADR 097](docs/adr/097-stable-mobile-library-navigation.md). Original Scroll artwork remains part of the public marketing identity; this correction introduces no shipping raster artwork. Product authority remains in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md), with the selected interaction scope in [the Atlas implementation contract](docs/design/ATLAS-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT-20261009.md).
keyCharacteristics: Cool light surfaces and matching dark surfaces with teal selection.
Favicon Home link and authenticated account avatar.
Stable saved-topic branches, scoped remembered position and evidence expanded inside each insight row.
Fully wrapped insight titles, semantic icons and right-side indicators for proven exact open-proposal totals: numbered bubbles for every positive count, including one, with exact accessible counts.
Five phone actions: Home, Library, Save, Projects, Account.
Short pointer-triggered motion with immediate keyboard actions and a still alternative.
Loaded-record statistics and explicitly recorded project trails.
Branch-owned Tree connectors fade and clip with their content; local pre-paint geometry retains path identity during motion and horizontal scrolling.

rules.name: The Recorded Meaning Rule
rules.body: Selection and connectors describe returned records; neither color nor a line establishes permission, independent corroboration or benefit.

rules.name: The Reading Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep title, explanation and metadata distinct through scale, weight and neutral contrast; use concise sentence case labels instead of ornamental eyebrows.

rules.name: The Touch Target Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls keep at least a 44px target; small type and icons do not justify a smaller hit area. Informational chips are not controls.

rules.name: The Cited Group Rule
rules.body: Display a connection only when all of its exact source, generation, revision and insight references exist in current permitted evidence. A connection is an explained cited group; neither its line nor topic membership proves causation or agreement.

rules.name: The Recorded Outcome Rule
rules.body: Present saving, evaluation, issue, PR, merge, deployment and benefit as separate recorded facts. A judgment is not a measured comparison, and a merged PR alone does not establish benefit.

dos: **Do** use cool light and matching dark surfaces with theme-primary selection.
**Do** use the favicon Home link and current authenticated avatar; keep all five bottom controls stable across app pages.
**Do** keep loading, empty, ready, success and error feedback tied to actual state.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, 44px controls and live reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep evidence, scope and recorded-outcome limits explicit.
donts: **Don't** turn filing templates into access scopes, invent parent links, exact totals, analysis completeness or benefit.
**Don't** make a pointer reveal delay keyboard reading or action.
**Don't** detach evidence from its insight row, remount navigation on evidence arrival, reorder siblings, traverse a fork or direct-evidence/child choice automatically, or auto-open an insight.
**Don't** publish private reference screenshots or turn a scoped fix verdict into production or full V1 acceptance.
